cards.name: Stray Cat
cards.purpose: Ten-copy swarm body. Intentionally weak so the copy-limit break creates quantity, not raw efficiency.

cards.name: Orange Menace
cards.purpose: Aggressive Cat that trades cheap swarm efficiency for immediate pressure.

cards.name: Tuxedo Cat
cards.purpose: Protects the colony while giving the opponent a visible target to clear.

cards.name: Cat Under the Bed
cards.purpose: Lets the Cat player preserve a body at the cost of temporarily dropping board count.

cards.name: Feral Tom
cards.purpose: Gives the swarm a way to attack opposing Ready Characters instead of only racing the Leader.

cards.name: Three-Legged Cat
cards.purpose: Resilient colony member that specifically resists Return and Dismiss counterplay.

cards.name: Alley Matriarch
cards.text: When this enters play, if you control 3 or more Cats, Draw a card.
cards.purpose: Rewards reaching the colony threshold without directly adding more Stash.

cards.name: Maine Coon
cards.text: While you control 5 or more Cats, this gets +2 Power.
cards.purpose: Visible five-Cat payoff that turns a wide colony into finishing pressure.

cards.name: House Panther
cards.purpose: Plain high-cost payoff for the extra-Stash engine. Tests whether the Leader's economy is enough reward by itself.

cards.name: Where's Mittens?
cards.text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Cat Character and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.
cards.purpose: Light Cat selection without generic Draw.

cards.name: Snowball
cards.text: At the start of your Turn, Snowball gets +1 Power.
cards.purpose: Fragile scaling threat. Rewards establishing Snowball early and protecting it with Cats such as Tuxedo Cat; returning it to hand naturally resets its accumulated Power.

cards.name: Trojan Cat
cards.text: When Trojan Cat is Defeated, deal 1 damage to every other Character.
cards.purpose: Cheap Cat-count body and visible blocking trap. Its global friendly-fire explosion can punish opposing boards but can also devastate the Cat Lady's own low-Guard colony.

cards.name: Dead Mouse in a Mousetrap
cards.purpose: Wide-board recovery tool. Rewards maintaining a colony and helps the Cat player recover from Trojan Cat friendly fire without directly adding more bodies.

cards.name: Hairy Cat
cards.text: Whenever Hairy Cat takes damage from a Character and survives, put a Hairball on that Character. A Character with a Hairball doesn't Ready during its controller's next Ready step. Then remove the Hairball.
cards.purpose: Defensive Cat that punishes repeated small attacks without becoming a hard wall: attackers that fail to Defeat it lose their next Ready, while a sufficiently strong hit kills it cleanly with no Hairball.

cards.name: Shoebox of Dead Cats
cards.text: Whenever one of your Cats is Dismissed, you may put it face down under a Shoebox of Dead Cats instead of into your discard. While you have 3 or more Cats face down under your Shoeboxes of Dead Cats, your Cats get +1 Power.
cards.purpose: Stores dismissed Cats as a hidden resource and rewards building a graveyard-like stockpile without releasing the whole pile for free.

cards.name: Shovel
cards.text: Randomly choose a face-down Cat under your Shoeboxes of Dead Cats and put it into play.
cards.purpose: Turns the Shoebox stockpile into unpredictable recovery. The Cat returns normally rather than with Hothead or reduced Guard.
